# `scaleselection`

each event's own size and rhythm, the best spatial and temporal level of the stored pairs by standardised response.

Version 2, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run scaleselection --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run scaleselection --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run scaleselection --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --spatial-scales '["parts 16","parts 32"]' --bands '["8-16 Hz","4-8 Hz"]'
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `recording` | field recording, each true, where {"name": "$recording"} | yes |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `recording` | `--recording` | `none` | - |  | the recording whose pairs are selected over (its name), or none: every recording of the subject, one run each |
| `spatial_scales` | `--spatial-scales` | none | mm |  | the spatial scales as quantities (the pair set is the product spatial_scales x bands) |
| `bands` | `--bands` | none | Hz |  | the temporal bands as quantities, Hz (each is the pair's rhythm; its time level is resolved from it) |
| `source` | `--source` | `global_bursts` | - |  | the pipeline whose stored labellings, cells and baselines are read (a labelling made by another is not used) |
| `response` | `--response` | `peak` | - | peak, mean | peak = the largest standardized cell amplitude of an event (blob-detection scale selection) \| mean = their mean |
| `min_link` | `--min-link` | `1` | pairs |  | events of two pairs are the same cross-pair event when at least this many pairs of their cells nest in space and overlap in time |
| `surface` | `--surface` | none | - |  | the subject's surface; null: the joint partitions' |
| `name` | `--name` | `{recording}_scale_selection` | - |  | the cross-pair events' Selection; its statistic is <name>.links |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before | [`select.scale_selection`](../nodes.md) | recording=recording | spatial_scales=$spatial_scales, bands=$bands, source=$source, response=$response, min_link=$min_link, surface=$surface | events, scale, links |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Outputs

| output | stored as |
|---|---|
| `events` | kind selection, type spans, name $name, on recording.time |
| `scale` | kind measurement, over events, of recording |
| `links` | kind statistic, name $name.links, of recording, over events, axes [{"name": "pair"}, {"name": "event"}] |

## Notes from the definition

```text
EACH EVENT'S OWN SIZE AND RHYTHM across a declared set of (spatial level, time level) pairs (spec docs/specs/2026-11-13-cortical-events.md, "Phase 2e"). From STORED rows only, no recording pass: what
`run global_bursts` stored for every pair of the product `spatial_scales` x `bands` (the cells' amplitude on the pair's joint Selection, the cells' per-tile baseline, the labelling of the pair's events on
the cells). Events of different pairs are linked by the ladders' exact nesting in space and overlap in time; the connected components are the cross-pair events; each one's response at every pair (its footprint),
best pair, the response there. Every missing pair is named, with the command that makes it.

Stored: the cross-pair events as a spans Selection on the recording's time line (`<name>`), measurements of the recording over it (scale_space_level, scale_time_level, scale_peak, scale_tile_area, scale_band_lo,
scale_band_hi, scale_pairs, scale_edge, and the footprint scale_response_s<l>_t<m> a pair), and the statistic `<name>.links` (the cross-pair event of each pair's event).

  nxr-neuro run scaleselection --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --spatial-scales '["parts 16","parts 32"]' --bands '["8-16 Hz","4-8 Hz"]'
```
